notes: Pfizer paid ~$6.7B all-cash for Arena Pharmaceuticals, whose lead asset etrasimod is an oral, once-daily, selective sphingosine 1-phosphate (S1P) receptor modulator for immuno-inflammatory disease. Etrasimod was in Phase 3 for ulcerative colitis at deal time and went on to FDA approval as Velsipity in Oct 2023. Peak-sales figure of $2.0B is a sell-side ESTIMATE reflecting consensus across UC and broader IBD/immunology indications (atopic dermatitis, eosinophilic esophagitis exploratory) — not a Pfizer-disclosed number. EV/peak of ~3.35x reflects an oral S1P modulator in a competitive UC market (vs Zeposia, JAK inhibitors).
selection_rationale: Clean single-lead-asset autoimmune small-molecule M&A with public deal terms. Oral S1P modulator for IBD anchors the autoimmune · small_molecule cohort alongside Receptos/ozanimod (same mechanism class) and Principia/rilzabrutinib (oral BTK).
source: Pfizer/Arena press release Dec 13 2021; Arena SEC filings; FDA Velsipity approval Oct 2023. Peak-sales is a sell-side consensus ESTIMATE (not company-disclosed).
